name: Miners' Union Card
summary: In Moonbrook, union cards mark the laborers lost beneath the earth. Workers once carried them through the mines, and now the cards remain with skeletal dead in the dark drifts.

sections.title: Tragedy in the Deep
sections.body: Before the Defias Brotherhood took control of Moonbrook, miners worked below ground for the guild, drawing valuable ore for the kingdom. A tunnel collapse crushed a major shaft and killed dozens beneath the rock. The dead rose as skeletal miners, excavators, and dynamiters. Union cards remain in their bony pockets, the last proof of who they were. In Stormwind, surviving colleagues seek the cards to learn the dead workers' identities and bring closure to their families.

faq.q: What is a Miners' Union Card?
faq.answer: A Miners' Union Card identified a member of the guild that worked the Moonbrook mines. Surviving workers use the cards to learn who died in the cave-in.

faq.q: Where do these cards come from?
faq.answer: The cards are found on undead laborers in the collapsed drifts beneath Moonbrook, including skeletal miners, undead excavators, and undead dynamiters.
A cave-in sealed the miners in a deep shaft. What raised them as undead is unknown; their remains now haunt the collapsed drifts beneath Moonbrook.
Surviving co-workers who escaped the cave-in and now live in Stormwind City seek the cards. They hope to tell the fallen miners' families what happened and bring them peace.

angles.text: For prospectors and miners, these cards recall the deadly risks of cave-ins and mine shafts left unmanaged.
Recovering the cards can bring closure to families across the kingdom of Stormwind who never learned what became of their working kin.
